title: Champion Valley Park
specs: Located on 150 acres of outdoor adventure space.
Largest and most popular field for simulated battle and special ops missions in Minnesota.
Groups younger than 12 require a reservation and a group minimum (6 or 8 depending on activity).
Private group booking option for 8+ participants.
Group sizes range from 6 to 300 depending on event.

blurb: Champion Valley Park is the largest outdoor simulated battle and special ops park in Minnesota, offering a variety of activities including paintball, airsoft, archery tag, axe throwing, and gelblasters on 150 acres of outdoor adventure space. Activities are available for ages 5 and up, and they offer specialized equipment for children.
